PancakeSwapV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every configured PancakeSwap V3 pool via on-chain NFT enumeration (NPM is ERC721Enumerable). Thin subclass of UniswapV3PoolsMeta overriding _slot0() to decode PancakeSwap V3's uint32 feeProtocol ABI plus the protocol-id slug. NonfungiblePositionManager pinned in the constructor; the active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (nav-config instances). 04 reads positionManager (the display name is derived from _protocolId(), not configured). Disabled: COW on Base has no feed, so a WETH/COW pool's COW leg cannot be valued — the adapter drops any instance whose tokens aren't both registered. Enable + add pool instances once COW is priced.

CoinbaseStakedEthWalletMeta.$comment: Wallet-held yield tokens (ADR 0010 meta family). Reports the RAW balanceOf of a token that is itself a registered, priced NAV asset, so the reported amount is bit-identical to what ERC20DefaultBalanceAdapter reported for the same holding - this reclassifies cbETH (Coinbase) from a generic wallet holding to a Staking position and changes NO value. Constructor takes only the NAV proxy, so the CREATE2 address is identical on every chain. The governed token set lives on NAVCalculator (see nav-config); claiming a token there automatically disarms the default adapter for it, so the two can never both report the same holding.
